{{Quote|It's experimental, but the TIE/sk x1 air superiority fighter is a demon in atmospheric environments.|[[Antoc Merrick]] in ''[[The Rebel Files]]''|<ref name="Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>}}
The '''TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter''', also known as the '''TIE/sk atmospheric fighter''' or simply the '''TIE striker''', was a streamlined variant of the [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] [[starfighter]]s used by the [[Galactic Empire]], most notably during the [[Battle of Scarif]]. Specialized for in-[[atmosphere]] missions, the [[atmospheric fighter]] was identifiable by its horizontal high-speed wings and large central pod. Largely because of its specialization for such missions, it was one of the few TIE models to be used by the [[Imperial Army]] as well as the [[Imperial Navy]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Pure_Sabacc_TIE_Striker_XWM.png|thumb|left|240px|The TIE striker performed optimally in atmospheric operations]]
The TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter<ref name="Visual Guide" /> featured flat, pointed wings specially designed for in-[[atmosphere]] [[Starfighter combat|combat]].<ref name="EW" /> Thus,<ref name="Visual Guide" /> it was faster than the standard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]].<ref name="Head to Head">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]'' states that the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] had a maximum speed of 1,200 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]], whilst ''Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide'' states that the TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter could attain speeds up to 1,500 kph.</ref>

However, the striker's wings were unusually shaped; straying from the typical [[TIE series|TIE fighter's]] wing shapes, the TIE/sk's wings helped increase the [[Starship|ship's]] VTOL (vertical take-off and landing) capacity.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> The craft was able to gain additional speed by curling down its wings,<ref name="EW" /> engaging from flight mode to attack mode.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

The fighter was heavily armed, sporting four pairs of [[Laser cannon|laser barrels]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> and [[proton bomb]]s that were particularly effective against vehicle units, dealing heavy damage over a large area.<ref name="Commander">''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''</ref> The TIE variant was equipped with [[ArmaTek]]'s [[VL-61/79 proton bomb]]s, which were deployed from a [[proton bomb]] chute fitted upon the [[armor]]ed [[hull]] of the craft's underside.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

Although its intended role was as an [[atmospheric fighter]], it could also be used as a [[starfighter]] to some extent,<ref name="Imperial Trainee card" /> and accompany standard TIE fighters.<ref name="SWCE" /> However, the attributes that made the striker a useful atmospheric fighter made it less than ideal in [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />

The TIE striker could be further modified with lightweight frames, thus allowing for an increased speed.<ref name="TIE Striker Expansion Pack">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Striker Expansion Pack}}</ref> The craft was also useful for shifting supplies and personnel from orbit to the [[planet]] surface, thanks to a larger central pod.<ref name="EW" />

==History==
===A New Order===
{{Quote|A design that emerged from the Empire's Scarif think tank, the TIE striker was built for atmospheric patrols over ground-based installations. While never a favorite of the Admiralty, forward-thinking commanders came to appreciate the TIE striker's combination of speed and armament, leading to a steady stream of orders from shipyards such as Corellia's.|The ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''|<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ImperialTrainee-XWM_Anthony_Devine.png|thumb|left|240px|A trio of Imperial cadets perform a fly-by of the Death Star.]]
The TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter served the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> They were new as of the second [[Empire Day]]<ref name="Voice of the Empire">{{InsiderCite|170|The Voice of the Empire}}</ref> in [[18 BBY]]<ref name="Introduction date" /> and flew during the parade. The [[HoloNet News]] reporter [[Calliope Drouth]] hoped to do a segment on them.<ref name="Voice of the Empire" />

In large part due to the decommissioning of many [[clone trooper]]s from the ranks of the [[Imperial Military]], fresh [[cadet]]s were often utilized for [[pilot]]ing the TIE striker, of which at least one squadron did a fly-by near the then-under construction [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="Imperial Trainee card" />

Sometime after the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] took ownership of the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', a TIE striker was located at [[Rekias Nodo]]'s [[Nodo's shipyard|shipyard]].<ref name="Choose your Adventure">''[[Choose Your Destiny: A Han & Chewie Adventure]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
====Spark of rebellion====
{{Quote|I've got one on my tail!|An [[Rebel pilot|X-wing pilot]] at the Battle of Scarif|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:Duchess_TIE_Striker_XWM.png|thumb|right|220px|The TIE striker served alongside Imperial forces.]]
By the [[time]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> of the [[Galactic Civil War]], a [[galaxy]]-wide conflict in which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] waged a rebellion against the Empire to restore [[Democracy|democratic]] [[Politics|rule]] to [[the galaxy]],<ref name="CL2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> the starfighter was utilized for in-[[atmosphere]] engagements and the defense of important Imperial bases.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> In particular, because of the secrecy behind the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial security complex]] on the jungle planet [[Scarif]] requiring a vigilant and swift defense force, the [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE pilots]] stationed there utilized the fighters.<ref name="Scarif Defender card">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Striker Expansion Pack|cardname=Scarif Defender}}</ref>

The TIE strikers notably defended Scarif during a Rebel [[Battle of Scarif|attack]]<ref name="EW" /> that was part of the Rebel mission to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to [[Project Stardust]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]]. During the battle, the TIE strikers entered dogfights with various Rebel aligned craft, with some also escorting a [[TIE/rp Reaper attack lander]] to deliver a squad of [[death trooper]]s to deal with [[Rogue One]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> The TIE pilot "[["Duchess"|Duchess]]" flew a striker in the battle.<ref name="Duchess X-Wing">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Striker Expansion Pack|cardname="Duchess"}}</ref>

[[File:Acme-ScarifStriker.png|thumb|left|300px|TIE Strikers fly in the Battle of Scarif]]
The [[human]] Imperial pilots "[[Countdown]]" and "[["Duchess"|Duchess]]"<ref name="Duchess">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Striker Expansion Pack|cardname="Duchess"}}</ref> were amongst those who serviced the Empire aboard TIE strikers. The foremost pilot<ref name="Human TIEs">The reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' states that the [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilots]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] were all [[human]]s.</ref> targeted a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] during the battle of Scarif.<ref name="Countdown">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Striker Expansion Pack|cardname="Countdown"}}</ref> Despite the efforts of Scarif's TIE striker pilots, the overall [[Scarif Deployment]], and the orbiting naval forces, the Battle of Scarif ended in<ref name="Rogue One" /> the Alliance's first major victory over the Empire<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> as Alliance strike team [[Rogue One]] was able to transmit the Stardust data plans to the orbiting [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> enabling the Alliance to destroy the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]] in the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> Other TIE striker crew members of the Galactic Civil War era included "[["Pure Sabacc"|Pure Sabacc]]," who served during the Civil War,<ref name="Pure Sabacc">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Striker Expansion Pack|cardname="Pure Sabacc"}}</ref> and [[Black Squadron (TIE striker)|Black Squadron]] of the Imperial [[Army Air Corps]].<ref name="Black Squadron TIE Striker">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Striker Expansion Pack|cardname=Black Squadron Scout}}</ref>

====Dusk of the Empire====
Imperial [[Governor]] [[Hastemoor]] had several TIE strikers in his planet's defense force on [[Troithe]]. After the [[Battle of Endor]], they [[Troithe operation|engaged]] the [[New Republic]] attackers during the [[Cerberon system campaign]], but were unable to keep the advancing forces from cutting off the capital.<ref name="Shadow Fall">''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]''</ref>

The TIE striker was still in the service of the Galactic Empire<ref name="Poe Dameron 9">[[Poe Dameron 9|''Poe Dameron'' 9]]</ref> in [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note #2">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[Battle of Jakku]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[5 ABY]].</ref> with several TIE strikers being present at the [[Rothana]] [[Rothana Imperial Shipyards|Imperial Shipyards]] around the time of the [[Battle of Jakku]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 9" /> During the battle itself, TIE strikers were utilized on [[Jakku]]'s surface to combat the [[New Republic]]. The Empire was ultimately defeated in the battle,<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> and thus ended the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="TFA VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

====Fighting the First Order on Naboo====
Several TIE strikers were used by the people of [[Naboo]] alongside [[N-1 starfighter]]s and [[X-wing starfighter]]s to fight off the [[First Order]], who brought a [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] and several of their own [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] in an attempt to get the people to surrender.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 5">[[Legacy of Vader 5|''Legacy of Vader'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The TIE striker was created and developed for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. The TIE striker was first revealed on [[May 17]], [[2016]], in a preview for ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story: The Official Visual Story Guide'', a cancelled reference book for the film that was rewritten as ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="Visual Guide" />
